messages:
marie-sales: Quick sync 52 WillowBank wants a 2-week POC to validate SSO + SCIM provisioning and confirm RBAC mapping before committing. They called out domain proofing, SCIM PATCH/delta, and delegated admin scoping.
luca-solutions: I can run the SAML exchange SP-initiated with Okta/AD FS. Need their IdP metadata and a test tenant. Can demo group->role mapping for RBAC.
sam-se: For Hosted demo: we store service keys and handle signing server-side (SHA-256). BYOK/HSM is Private-only. SCIM is metered on API requests for Hosted; Dedicated can include negotiated provisioning throughput.
elaine-sales: WillowBank asked whether SCIM calls impact billing and if we can guarantee rate limits for nightly syncs.
sam-se: SCIM counts as API usage on Hosted. For the POC we can temporarily bump rate limits or use sandbox with burst capacity. If they have sustained high throughput, Dedicated is recommended.
anna-security: Security checklist:
- Provide DNS TXT for domain verification (we issue the token)
- IdP metadata (XML) exchange and SP ACS/EntityID confirmation
- SCIM service account credentials + rotation policy
- Requirement: signed assertions, SHA-256, and audit logs
Note: BYOK for signing requires Private deployment. Flagging that as likely blocker.
vikram-se: SCIM implementation details for the test plan:
- Must support PATCH (RFC 7644) for delta updates
- Default Hosted rate limit: 10 req/sec, can be increased for POC
- Header: Authorization: Bearer X-SCIM-TOKEN
- Example group payload:
  POST /scim/v2/Groups
  { "displayName": "willowbank-helpdesk", "members":[{"value":"user-123"}] }
luca-solutions: Delegated admin: we can map groups to roles for the demo (e.g., willowbank-helpdesk -> helpdesk role). Full delegated-admin UI is product work and out of scope for 2-week POC.
marie-sales: Action items:
- WillowBank to provide IdP metadata XML and confirm ownership of willowbank-app domain (DNS TXT)
- sam-se to produce hosted vs dedicated pricing sketch including SCIM burst and 24/7 SRE add-on
- luca-solutions to prepare SAML exchange and RBAC mapping demo
- anna-security to draft questionnaire responses and note BYOK constraint
- infra-bot to provision demo sandbox once inputs arrive
infra-bot: demo-sandbox: Provisioning window 48 hours after metadata + admin user received. 7-day free sandbox for sales POCs.
elaine-sales: I'll ask WillowBank if they can provide a CSV for initial seed import to avoid heavy delta traffic at start.
marie-sales: Great. I'll collect the metadata today and push back on BYOK requirement (we can discuss Private deployment). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
